paragraphs.text: Amonkhet is accompanied by Booster Battle Packs . The Booster Battle Packs contain two single-color 30-card 2017 Welcome Decks and two Amonkhet booster packs .
Each sample deck contains basic lands , commons , 4 uncommons and 1 rare . Besides the Welcome Deck 2017 cards the decks also contain cards from Kaladesh , Aether Revolt and Amonkhet .
The Amonkhet Booster Battle Packs are not available at Wizards Play Network stores, but only at large "big-box" stores like Walmart or Target.
